pillars.label: Reasoning & knowledge
pillars.blurb: Hard problems with verifiable answers: graduate science, competition maths, research-level maths, and whether the model knows what it does not know.

pillars.label: Coding
pillars.blurb: Resolving real GitHub issues, multi-language edits, scientific code and competitive programming — measured by running the code, not by asking a judge.

pillars.label: Human preference
pillars.blurb: Blind head-to-head votes from people using the models on their own prompts. Captures the qualities benchmarks miss, and the taste benchmarks cannot score.

pillars.label: Agentic capability
pillars.blurb: Long-horizon work with tools: terminals, real computers, and how long a task can run before the model loses the plot.

pillars.label: Cost efficiency
pillars.blurb: Blended price per million tokens on a log scale, because the gap between $1 and $10 matters far more than the gap between $60 and $70.
